command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$names=@('docker','psql','pg_isready','pg_dump','pg_restore','pwsh','python','node','npm.cmd','uv')
$toolList=@($names | ForEach-Object { $c=Get-Command $_ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; [pscustomobject]@{name=$_; available=[bool]$c; path=if($c){$c.Source}else{$null}} })
$svc=@(Get-Service | Where-Object {$_.Name -match 'postgres|docker'} | Select-Object Name,Status)
$proc=@(Get-Process | Where-Object {$_.ProcessName -match 'postgres|docker'} | Select-Object ProcessName,Id)
$listen=@(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.LocalPort -in @(5432,5433,15432)} | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess)
$pgPaths=@(); if(Test-Path -LiteralPath 'C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL') {$pgPaths=@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath 'C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL' -Directory | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name)}
[pscustomobject]@{powershell=$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString();tools=$toolList;services=$svc;processes=$proc;pg_listeners=$listen;postgres_program_files_versions=$pgPaths;docker_desktop_executable=(Test-Path -LiteralPath 'C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\Docker Desktop.exe');root_env_exists=(Test-Path -LiteralPath '.env')} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress
